# Indian Community

> > Local Indian community platform connecting diaspora members with businesses, classifieds, and networking opportunities across cities like Chennai, Atlanta, and Alpharetta.

Indian Community is a hyperlocal platform serving the Indian diaspora with business directories, classified listings, and membership-based community engagement. The platform features businesses like Nursing Station Healthcare Pvt. Ltd., Husky Restorations LLC, and Gupta Real Estate Group across multiple geographic markets.

- Indian diaspora network
- Local business directory
- Classifieds platform
- Community membership
- Chennai, Tamil Nadu

## Getting Started

- [Join Local Indian Community Near You](https://local.indian.community/): Homepage for local Indian community platform with classifieds & businesses
- [Join Indian Community - Today!](https://local.indian.community/join): Membership signup page for Indian community platform
